verse.unicode: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧

transliteration.english: dhanaasaree chha(n)t mahalaa chauthhaa ghar pehilaa

en.bdb: Dhanaasaree, Chhant, Fourth Mehla, First House:

verse.unicode: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥

transliteration.english: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||

en.bdb: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verse.unicode: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਜੀਉ ॥

transliteration.english: har jeeau kirapaa kare taa naam dhiaaieeaai jeeau ||

en.bdb: When the Dear Lord grants His Grace, one meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verse.unicode: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਸਹਜਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਐ ਜੀਉ ॥

transliteration.english: satigur milai subhai sahaj gun gaieeaai jeeau ||

en.bdb: Meeting the True Guru, through loving faith and devotion, one intuitively sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verse.unicode: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਸਦਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾ ਆਪਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਵਏ ॥

transliteration.english: gun gai vigasai sadhaa anadhin jaa aap saache bhaave ||

en.bdb: Singing His Glorious Praises continually, night and day, one blossoms forth, when it is pleasing to the True Lord.

verse.unicode: ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਜੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵਏ ॥

transliteration.english: aha(n)kaar haumai tajai maiaa sahaj naam samaave ||

en.bdb: Egotism, self-conceit and Maya are forsaken, and he is intuitively absorbed into the Naam.

verse.unicode: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਆਪਿ ਦੇਇ ਤ ਪਾਈਐ ॥

transliteration.english: aap karataa kare soiee aap dhei ta paieeaai ||

en.bdb: The Creator Himself acts; when He gives, then we receive.

verse.unicode: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥

transliteration.english: har jeeau kirapaa kare taa naam dhiaaieeaai jeeau ||1||

en.bdb: When the Dear Lord grants His Grace, we meditate on the Naam. ||1||

verse.unicode: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਨੇਹੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੈ ਜੀਉ ॥

transliteration.english: a(n)dhar saachaa neh poore satigurai jeeau ||

en.bdb: Deep within, I feel true love for the Perfect True Guru.

verse.unicode: ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਮੈ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਜੀਉ ॥

transliteration.english: hau tis sevee dhin raat mai kadhe na veesarai jeeau ||

en.bdb: I serve Him day and night; I never forget Him.

verse.unicode: ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵਿਸਾਰੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਮੑਾਰੀ ਜਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਈ ਤਾ ਜੀਵਾ ॥

transliteration.english: kadhe na visaaree anadhin sam(h)aaree jaa naam liee taa jeevaa ||

en.bdb: I never forget Him; I remember Him night and day. When I chant the Naam, then I live.

verse.unicode: ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਸੁਣੀ ਤ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਾ ॥

transliteration.english: sravanee sunee ta ih man tirapatai gurmukh a(n)mrit peevaa ||

en.bdb: With my ears, I hear about Him, and my mind is satisfied. As Gurmukh, I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar.

verse.unicode: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਚਰੈ ॥

transliteration.english: nadhar kare taa satigur mele anadhin bibek budh bicharai ||

en.bdb: If He bestows His Glance of Grace, then I shall meet the True Guru; my discriminating intellect would contemplate Him, night and day.

verse.unicode: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਨੇਹੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੈ ॥੨॥

transliteration.english: a(n)dhar saachaa neh poore satigurai ||2||

en.bdb: Deep within, I feel true love for the Perfect True Guru. ||2||

verse.unicode: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਆਵਏ ਜੀਉ ॥

transliteration.english: satasa(n)gat milai vaddabhaag taa har ras aave jeeau ||

en.bdb: By great good fortune, one joins the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation; then, one comes to savor the subtle essence of the Lord.

verse.unicode: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ਤ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਏ ਜੀਉ ॥

transliteration.english: anadhin rahai liv lai ta sahaj samaave jeeau ||

en.bdb: Night and day, he remains lovingly focused on the Lord; he merges in celestial peace.

verse.unicode: ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਅਤੀਤੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥

transliteration.english: sahaj samaavai taa har man bhaavai sadhaa ateet bairaagee ||

en.bdb: Merging in celestial peace, he becomes pleasing to the Lord's Mind; he remains forever unattached and untouched.

verse.unicode: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਜਗ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥

transliteration.english: halat palat sobhaa jag a(n)tar raam naam liv laagee ||

en.bdb: He receives honor in this world and the next, lovingly focused on the Lord's Name.

verse.unicode: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਦੁਹਾ ਤੇ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਭਾਵਏ ॥

transliteration.english: harakh sog dhuhaa te mukataa jo prabh kare su bhaave ||

en.bdb: He is liberated from both pleasure and pain; he is pleased by whatever God does.

verse.unicode: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਆਵਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥

transliteration.english: satasa(n)gat milai vaddabhaag taa har ras aave jeeau ||3||

en.bdb: By great good fortune, one joins the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and then, one comes to savor the subtle essence of the Lord. ||3||

verse.unicode: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਜਮਿ ਜੋਹਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥

transliteration.english: dhoojai bhai dhukh hoi manmukh jam johiaa jeeau ||

en.bdb: In the love of duality, there is pain and suffering; the Messenger of Death eyes the self-willed manmukhs.

verse.unicode: ਹਾਇ ਹਾਇ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੁਖਿ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥

transliteration.english: hai hai kare dhin raat maiaa dhukh mohiaa jeeau ||

en.bdb: They cry and howl, day and night, caught by the pain of Maya.

verse.unicode: ਮਾਇਆ ਦੁਖਿ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਹਿਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਤ ਵਿਹਾਵਏ ॥

transliteration.english: maiaa dhukh mohiaa haumai rohiaa meree meree karat vihaave ||

en.bdb: Caught by the pain of Maya, provoked by his ego, he passes his life crying out, ""Mine, mine!"".

verse.unicode: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੇਇ ਤਿਸੁ ਚੇਤੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਏ ॥

transliteration.english: jo prabh dhei tis chetai naahee a(n)t giaa pachhutaave ||

en.bdb: He does not remember God, the Giver, and in the end, he departs regretting and repenting.

verse.unicode: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਚਾਲੈ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਮਾਇਆ ਧੋਹਿਆ ॥

transliteration.english: bin naavai ko saath na chaalai putr kalatr maiaa dhohiaa ||

en.bdb: Without the Name, nothing shall go along with him; not his children, spouse or the enticements of Maya.

verse.unicode: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਜਮਿ ਜੋਹਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥

transliteration.english: dhoojai bhai dhukh hoi manmukh jam johiaa jeeau ||4||

en.bdb: In the love of duality, there is pain and suffering; the Messenger of Death eyes the self-willed manmukhs. ||4||

verse.unicode: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੇਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਮਹਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥

transliteration.english: kar kirapaa leh milai mahal har paiaa jeeau ||

en.bdb: Granting His Grace, the Lord has merged me with Himself; I have found the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

verse.unicode: ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥

transliteration.english: sadhaa rahai kar joR prabh man bhaiaa jeeau ||

en.bdb: I remain standing with my palms pressed together; I have become pleasing to God's Mind.

verse.unicode: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥

transliteration.english: prabh man bhaavai taa hukam samaavai hukam ma(n)n sukh paiaa ||

en.bdb: When one is pleasing to God's Mind, then he merges in the Hukam of the Lord's Command; surrendering to His Hukam, he finds peace.

verse.unicode: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਪਤ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥

transliteration.english: anadhin japat rahai dhin raatee sahaje naam dhiaaiaa ||

en.bdb: Night and day, he chants the Lord's Name, day and night; intuitively, naturally, he meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verse.unicode: ਨਾਮੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਏ ॥

transliteration.english: naamo naam milee vaddiaaiee naanak naam man bhaave ||

en.bdb: Through the Naam, the glorious greatness of the Naam is obtained; the Naam is pleasing to Nanak's mind.

verse.unicode: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੇਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਮਹਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਵਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥੧॥

transliteration.english: kar kirapaa leh milai mahal har paave jeeau ||5||1||

en.bdb: Granting His Grace, the Lord has merged me with Himself; I have found the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||5||1||
